body:
Independent review reported `W07-W05-MAT-PARENT-001`, an additional exact-target scope of the parent-grounding mechanism in #1202. The current W05 Soy peptone and generic Peptone proposals retain only FALLBACK_REGISTRY self-mappings despite source-supported protein-hydrolysate families. This is inherited incompleteness, not a regression introduced by the final provenance corrections.

Exact current payloads remain unchanged at published `76bca688b4f55e8bdf791079df8d4156cded6c4c`: `W05-FINAL-MAT-032` Soy_Peptone SHA256 `e37e3230f9b4489e715cda9c1785f30ea97305d1d6264045bea75b92312bf236`, and `W05-FINAL-MAT-039` Peptone SHA256 `61590bc2de78646c368ed1fb21c2c29bbc041d9f248e8a712c578376e776996d`. The manufacturer guide defines the protein-digest family without requiring a supplier or mammalian origin. Bound FoodOn evidence identifies FOODON:03315720 vegetable protein, hydrolyzed and FOODON:03315306 protein hydrolyzates. Inspect their complete ontology scope/annotations and source applicability before choosing the closest supported parent and asymmetric predicate under MAPPING_SEMANTICS section3; a label alone is not sufficient.

Complete the supported nonidentity family relation while preserving each distinct local identity and native registry obligation. Do not restore the unsupported mammalian identity, infer a branded Soytone/Phytone product, assert an anatomical has-part relation, merge owners or approve roles/exports. Preserve source/form/organism holds, old objects/history and exact source-case lineage. Use a guarded successor with native projected rows and independent complete-byte review; if a proposed parent is unsupported after full inspection, document the precise reason rather than guessing.

Independent finding: W07 `.temp/w05-final-correction-independent-v1/review/materials/findings.json`, SHA256 `2f9624cecfe18322f75b75c7ba2247a6fbe68aabc40cdb93c66e1e175baa603d`. Root froze the reported index at `.temp/all-unmatched-20261107/preflight/w05-final-completion-findings-publication-v1/review-finding-index-at-read.json` SHA256 `9587223471020191df48220150bf0c875e7b011a3dcd1c2de0731fd9a67e6e7e` and checked the actual current payloads and ontology captures. Manufacturer PDF SHA256 `963de777a42013795b1dd6f3fd2820ef3010d659fa501d5991d18cebd0243fa6`; FoodOn captures `aa063e8b88177611aba640828e84d3982b1b3b1c65b11647d89c9efbf6274c25` and `c6264c268afeadcb47631173e6a803cbf9a0b7a8c08fda990df55ee260680f28`. Reported before dependent fixes; no source application or approval occurred.
